notes: Covers firefighters as defined in RCW 41.26.030(16)(a),(b),(c),(h), including private-sector firefighters in departments of 50 or more employees. A pre-employment psychological exam, administered by a psychiatrist or psychologist and ruling out PTSD from pre-employment exposures, is required for employees hired after the law's effective date. Excluded: PTSD directly attributed to disciplinary action, a work evaluation, job transfer, layoff, demotion, termination, or similar personnel action. Enacted 2018 (2018 c 264, SSB 6214), effective June 7, 2018. Note: public employee fire investigators, though added to the base disease-presumption group (respiratory, heart, cancer, and infectious disease) in 2019, are explicitly excluded from this PTSD presumption — a genuine coverage gap worth flagging.
